metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: Snap, JPMorgan, AMD, SpaceX

content.text:
Updated 9 hours ago
Stocks to Watch: Snap, JPMorgan, AMD, SpaceX
↗️ SpaceX (SPCX): Shares of Elon Musk’s rocket company wrapped up another day of gains, following a two-day rally that put the stock about 43% above its IPO price. Shares rose 4.8% Tuesday, pushing SpaceX's market cap above Amazon's.
↘️Robinhood Markets (HOOD): Shares in the brokerage ticked 1.4% lower after it said it would lay off about 10% of its workforce to cut costs and improve efficiency. The move will impact about 290 jobs.
↘️ Snap (SNAP): Snap debuted augmented reality glasses that go for $2,195, in a bet that smartglasses will become consumers' go-to computing device. Investors were skeptical, sending the technology company's shares down 9.6%.
